refnamediv.refpurpose: Restrict a player to one chat message or voice command per minute.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: nospam restricts a player to one chat message or voice command per minute. An optional TIME parameter sets the duration (e.g. 5m, 1h). If no time is specified, the restriction is permanent until manually removed. Public, team, private and admin chat and voice commands share the same minute. Restrictions and the last permitted message are saved in SQLite and survive reconnects, map changes and server restarts. The player must be authenticated and the database available. Use !unnospam PLAYER to remove it.
